_comment: Hero copy — source of truth. deploy.sh:apply_copy rewrites the hero object of every language block in site/index.html and site/GeorgeAI.dc.html from this file on every deploy, so a re-export from the design tool cannot silently revert it. Positioning follows the five commercial priorities in seo/services.json — lead with #1 (vibe code: Python/Django/PostgreSQL apps built fast), name #2 (n8n automation) and #3 (CRM/ERP) in the sub; SEO/GEO/AIO and AI consulting live on /services/. Proof claims must stay inside what the site can back: 8+ years, 40+ projects, 15+ technologies, five languages, ~2-week pilot. Mirror any message change into seo/noscript.html, which is what crawlers and AI engines read.
